newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM Cargo seeks Airbus freighter.
newsitem.headline: KLM Cargo seeks Airbus freighter.

text.p: KLM Cargo will increase capacity on its intra-European network with the introduction of a leased Airbus A300B4 freighter, a KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV Cargo spokesman said.
"The aircraft will be used to replace a Shorts Belfast freighter now leased in from HeavyLift Cargo Airlines of the UK," he added.

A spokesman for UK-based HeavyLift said he understood that while the 40-tonne capacity Airbus will be used to replace the Belfast on some of the latter's routes within Europe, the Belfast will continue to be used by KLM.
Asked whether HeavyLift will be buying or leasing an existing Airbus converted freighter or obtaining an Airbus for conversion, he replied that all options were possible.
HeavyLift declined to say when the Airbus might be acquired, although the KLM spokesman said the plane is scheduled for introduction during the summer season.
HeavyLift is part of the Kvaerner ASA group.
